name: Taparia ATS-10 Drop Forged Aviation Tin Cutter with Spring (10-Inch)
shortDescription: 10-inch drop-forged alloy steel aviation tin snip with induction-hardened serrated jaws, compound leverage action, and spring-assisted handles for sheet metal.
overview: The Taparia ATS-10 is a heavy-duty 250mm (10-inch) aviation tin snip engineered to slice effortlessly through mild steel sheet, galvanized iron, stainless steel, and aluminium sheeting. Forged from high-grade alloy steel and induction-hardened to 55-60 HRC, its precision micro-serrated blades grip sheet metal securely to eliminate slipping and produce crisp, curl-free straight and curved cuts. The double-pivot compound toggle linkage amplifies hand pressure by over 800%, while an auto-latch safety lock and spring-loaded handles facilitate fast, fatigue-free repetitive cutting.
keyFeatures: Drop-forged Chrome-Molybdenum alloy steel jaws for maximum edge retention
Precision micro-serrations on cutting edges prevent material slippage during cuts
Compound leverage double-pivot mechanism drastically multiplies cutting power
Cuts up to 1.2 mm cold-rolled mild steel sheet and 0.7 mm stainless steel sheet
Spring-loaded handles automatically return after every stroke for rapid shearing
Convenient one-handed thumb-activated safety latch locks jaws securely for storage
Ergonomic bi-material contoured handles with slip-resistant finger guards
applications: HVAC ductwork manufacturing, plenums, and damper trimming
Roof flashing, gutters, downspouts, and corrugated sheet cutting
Automotive sheet metal panel shaping, floor pan repairs, and patching
Drywall steel stud and track cutting, aluminium cladding trim
packageContents: 1x Taparia ATS-10 Aviation Tin Cutter (Straight / Universal Cut)
